continuity: Taekyung has moved out of the Jin Family home and into a Bucheon officetel three days before this chapter; Jinho hyung is the only person he expects to find there.
Park Jihoon and Taekyung reconnect after eleven years without regular contact, following only a brief conversation a few months earlier.
Park Jihoon owns a luxury officetel in Cheongdam-dong and is wealthy enough to maintain it as a private retreat.
Park Jihoon is nominally a Hunter on Myeongdong Guild Team 1, but the nominal Team 1 Leader recognizes Jihoon's superior authority and obeys his directions.
Jihoon has been informed that higher-ups find Jin Taekyung irritating and has begun arranging an A-Rank raid at the earliest available date in connection with the Taekyung matter.
plot: Jin Taekyung accepts Park Jihoon's invitation to drink and learns that Jihoon transferred into their middle school in his second year, attended Hankuk University's Business Administration department, awakened before graduating, and comes from a family that has operated a Hunter-related business for more than thirty years. After an enjoyable reunion, Jihoon takes a separate call and reveals that his nominal Myeongdong Guild Team 1 Leader answers to him; Jihoon orders the earliest possible A-Rank raid and says the higher-ups find Taekyung irritating, implying that the raid is intended to remove him under cover of a Gate accident.
translation_decisions: Render 한국대 and 한국대학교 as Hankuk University.
Render 게이트 관리청 as Gate Management Agency.
Retain somaek for 소맥 and render 기레기 as trash reporters.

active_continuity: Mae Jonghak is publicly recognized as the Sword Saint despite his Returned to Youth appearance.
Cheongpung can move again and wanted to see Taekyung as soon as he woke; dumplings quieted him.
Jeok Cheongang remains unconscious; the Luoyang Strange Physician examined him but said there was no treatment available for now.
Taekyung considers Jeok both his Master and the equivalent of a close grandfather.
Mae suspects Dark Heaven may seek direct confrontation or may be a smokescreen or subordinate organization of the Demonic Cult.
The Blood Lord, Temporary Strength Pill, and Exploding Blood Demonic Art carry the Demonic Cult's scent, but the Blood Lord's sorcery is darker and unfamiliar.
Hong Dao's letter calls Taekyung the Morning Star who will drive away darkness.
Taekyung has returned to the modern world after more than a year in Murim and slept for forty-two hours after Logout.
The Peace Guild's new-member workshop was held at an A-rank Gate where rookies defeated a Stone Golem before Iron Golems appeared.
Taekyung killed more than ten Level 95 Iron Golems and soloed the boss monster in a few minutes.
White Flame is a bound spear made from Ten-Thousand-Year Cold Iron; only Taekyung can use it, and it alone crosses between his Murim and modern-world inventories.
Team Leader Choi and Butler Kim consider describing Taekyung as an unprecedented second-awakened Hunter sufficient and will not press him about his deeper secret.
Team Leader Choi intends to collect Taekyung's debt with interest, but his larger motive remains unstated.
The Peace Guild raid ended after three days instead of the planned six nights and seven days because Taekyung eliminated the available monsters.
Im Kkeokjeong left the raid abruptly in his equipment because of an unspecified urgent matter.
After a brief encounter a few months earlier, Park Jihoon invited Taekyung to drink and reconnected with him after eleven years without regular contact.
Taekyung moved out of the Jin Family home into a Bucheon officetel three days before this chapter.
Park Jihoon attended Hankuk University's Business Administration department but has not graduated since awakening.
Park Jihoon is nominally a Myeongdong Guild Team 1 Hunter, but the nominal Team 1 Leader treats Jihoon's position as hollow and follows his orders.
Jihoon says higher-ups find Taekyung irritating and orders the earliest possible A-Rank raid in connection with the Taekyung matter.
open_questions: Will Jeok Cheongang regain consciousness and recover?
Is the Blood Lord affiliated with the Demonic Cult?
Is Dark Heaven a front or subordinate organization of the Demonic Cult?
Why was the Blood Lord so intent on taking the Green Jade Buddha Staff?
What is the nature and scope of the Blood Lord's unfamiliar sorcery and the method used to make the attackers appear?
What urgent problem caused Im Kkeokjeong to leave the raid?
Who are Jihoon's higher-ups and the person referred to as 'that person,' and what organization or authority do they represent?
Is the planned earliest A-Rank raid intended to remove Taekyung as a Gate accident?
temporary_decisions: Render 낙양괴의 as Luoyang Strange Physician and 술법 as sorcery, distinct from movement techniques and lightness skills.
Retain Morning Star for 신성 and render 염왕채 as Yama's Debt.
Render 스톤 골렘 and 아이언 골렘 as Stone Golem and Iron Golem.
Retain Haste, Strength, Healing, and Fire Wall for the named spells.
Render 국정원 as NIS and 백염 as White Flame.
Render 소맥 as somaek and 기레기 as trash reporters.
Render 한국대 and 한국대학교 as Hankuk University.
Render 게이트 관리청 as Gate Management Agency.
